zh.boundary: 该技能不负责解释法律条文的具体含义、提供法律咨询建议、构建前端 UI 组件，或进行与法律无关的通用网页抓取。

skills.name: 200-agents-md
skills.summary: Use when you need to generate an AGENTS.md file for a Java repository — covering project conventions, tech stack, file structure, commands, Git workflow, and contributor boundaries — through a modular, step-based interactive process that adapts to your specific project needs. This should trigger for requests such as Create AGENTS.md; Update AGENTS.md file; Add agent instructions. Part of cursor-rules-java project

en.purpose: Interactively generates or updates a comprehensive AGENTS.md file for Java repositories to establish tech stacks, workflows, and AI agent boundaries.
scenarios: Creating a new AGENTS.md file for a Java project from scratch
Updating existing agent guidelines and project conventions in a repository
Establishing clear permission boundaries (Always do / Ask first / Never do) for AI collaborators
en.io: Inputs user input from interactive prompts and repository file context, and outputs a formatted AGENTS.md markdown file.
en.boundary: It generates documentation and agent guidelines, but does not execute project build commands or modify actual source code files.

zh.purpose: 通过模块化交互流程为 Java 项目生成或更新 AGENTS.md 指南文件，以规范 AI Agent 的技术栈、工作流及行为边界。
scenarios: 从零开始为 Java 项目创建全新的 AGENTS.md 文件
更新现有仓库中的 AI Agent 操作指南、命令行规范与 Git 工作流
为 AI 协作者设定明确的执行权限边界（始终执行 / 提前询问 / 严禁执行）
zh.io: 输入用户交互提示的回答与仓库文件上下文，输出结构化的 AGENTS.md 文档。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于引导互动与生成 Agent 规范文档，不执行项目构建部署命令或修改项目的实际源代码。

skills.name: 003-agents-installation
skills.summary: Use when you need to install the embedded robot agents into either .cursor/agents or .claude/agents, selecting the destination interactively and copying the embedded agent definitions from project assets. This should trigger for requests such as Install embedded agents; Bootstrap .cursor/agents; Bootstrap .claude/agents; Copy robot agents. Part of cursor-rules-java project

en.purpose: Interactively installs embedded robot agent definitions into either the .cursor/agents or .claude/agents directory.
scenarios: Bootstrapping the .cursor/agents directory with standard agent definitions
Setting up the .claude/agents directory for Claude Code usage
Re-installing or updating embedded agent definition files in a project
en.io: Takes the user's interactive target directory selection as input and outputs copied agent files into the destination along with a summary report.
en.boundary: This skill strictly handles copying predefined agent files to the selected directory and does not configure agent logic or modify other project files.

zh.purpose: 通过交互方式引导用户选择目标路径，将预定义的嵌入式 Agent 配置文件安装至 .cursor/agents 或 .claude/agents 目录。
scenarios: 在项目中初始化 .cursor/agents 目录下的 Agent 配置文件
为 Claude Code 环境配置 .claude/agents 目录及其 Agent 定义
重新安装或更新项目中的 Agent 配置文件
zh.io: 输入用户的目标路径选择，输出复制到指定目录的 Agent 配置文件以及安装结果报告。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅负责将预定义的 Agent 文件复制到指定目录，不包含对 Agent 逻辑的修改或对其他项目文件的调整。

en.purpose: Update skill documentation and templates to require AI agents to use their real identities in worklogs.
scenarios: Updating worklog templates to remove hardcoded agent identity placeholders
Establishing guidelines for maintaining accurate audit logs in agent tasks
Revising skill conventions to enforce identity compliance
en.io: Inputs documentation files and templates; outputs updated skill rules and non-hardcoded templates.
en.boundary: Does not enforce agent identity checking via code or automated script logic.

zh.purpose: 更新技能文档与模板，要求 AI Agent 在工作日志中使用真实的 Agent 身份。
scenarios: 更新工作日志模板以移除硬编码的 Agent 身份占位符
建立规范以确保 Agent 任务审计日志的真实性与准确性
修订技能约定文件以强调身份使用规则
zh.io: 输入为现有文档与模板文件，输出为包含最新身份规范的文档与动态模板。
zh.boundary: 不包含在脚本或代码层面上对 Agent 身份进行的自动化技术强制校验。

skills.name: transcript-fixer
skills.summary: Corrects speech-to-text transcription errors with dictionary rules and Claude's built-in AI (no external API key required); Native AI Correction is the default, Stage 1 alone is incomplete, and Stage 3 API is only for automation without Claude Code. Builds personalized correction databases, loads person-name ASR variants from the configured global people roster, and reads per-domain contexts for homophones. Before correcting a person name, the agent must consult both the global roster and the owning project's identity roster; project rosters are not auto-loaded, and occurrence frequency is never identity evidence. Use for ASR/STT output with recognition errors, homophones, garbled technical terms, person-name errors, or mixed Chinese/English, and for cleaning meeting notes, lecture transcripts, interviews, or any speech-recognition text—even when the user only says “fix this transcript,” “clean up these meeting notes,” or mentions a garbled name.

skills.name: terminal-screenshot
skills.summary: Render a terminal CLI program's colored output to a PNG so Claude can actually SEE the real visual result — color contrast, alignment, background blocks, highlighting — instead of only reading plain text and raw ANSI escape codes. Use this whenever verifying or debugging how a CLI tool looks in the terminal: delta git diff colors, bat syntax highlighting, starship prompt, eza/ls colors, git diff, ripgrep matches, or any ANSI-colored output. ALWAYS use it right after changing any CLI color config (delta / bat / themes / lazygit pager) to visually confirm the result rather than guessing from hex values — reading a hex code is not the same as seeing the rendered contrast on the real terminal background. Trigger phrases: 看终端效果, 终端截图, 验证配色, 配色对比, 终端真实效果, terminal screenshot, render terminal output, ANSI to image, "does this color look right", "is the contrast enough", delta/bat color verification.

skills.name: stepfun-tts
skills.summary: Generate Chinese / Japanese speech with StepFun's stepaudio-2.5-tts — Contextual TTS that replaces step-tts-2's `voice_label` with natural-language `instruction` (≤200 chars) plus inline `()` parentheses for句内 prosody. Use when the user wants emotional / prosody control over voice synthesis (whisper, pause, stress, mood pivot mid-sentence), batch-generates game / app voice lines, migrates from `step-tts-2` (the `voice_label → instruction` breaking change), or hits StepFun's stricter 2.5-era censorship (死/消失/political terms). Triggers on 阶跃 TTS, StepAudio 合成, 语音合成, 配音, 文本转语音, TTS 升级, 迁移 step-tts-2. For transcription with the sibling stepaudio-2.5-asr model, use the stepfun-asr skill instead.

en.purpose: Generates Chinese or Japanese speech with StepFun stepaudio-2.5-tts using natural-language global instructions and inline parenthetical prosody directions.
scenarios: Synthesize emotional or whispered speech with sentence-level prosody changes.
Batch-generate game or application voice lines.
Migrate integrations from step-tts-2 voice_label parameters to stepaudio-2.5-tts instructions.
en.io: Inputs are text up to the documented model limit, optional instruction text, batch JSONL, voice/model settings, and an output path. Outputs are synthesized audio files plus batch logs or skipped-line records.
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY or plugin config containing a Normal API key
Optional shell comparison tooling for A/B evaluation
en.boundary: Targets TTS, not transcription. The model rejects legacy voice_label, limits instruction and input length, and may block sensitive content. Pricing and service behavior are volatile and require external re-verification.

zh.purpose: 使用 StepFun 的 stepaudio-2.5-tts，通过自然语言全局指令和文本内括号韵律指令生成中文或日文语音。
scenarios: 合成带情绪、耳语或句内语气变化的语音。
批量生成游戏或应用配音台词。
将 step-tts-2 的 voice_label 集成迁移到 stepaudio-2.5-tts 的 instruction 方式。
zh.io: 输入为受模型长度限制的文本、可选 instruction、批量 JSONL、音色/模型设置和输出路径；输出为合成音频，以及批处理日志或跳过记录。
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY 或插件配置中的 Normal API Key
内置 Python 生成脚本
A/B 对比可选的 Shell 工具
zh.boundary: 仅用于语音合成，不用于转写。模型不接受旧版 voice_label，并限制 instruction 和输入长度，也可能拦截敏感内容。价格和服务行为具有时效性，引用前需重新核实。

skills.name: stepfun-asr
skills.summary: Transcribe audio with StepFun's stepaudio-2.5-asr — an SSE endpoint (NOT /v1/audio/transcriptions) with 32K context, ~85-101x RTF on long audio, and a single-call ceiling around 30 minutes (no client-side chunking). Use when transcribing Chinese / English audio with StepFun, when long-form recordings (5-30 min) need to land in one request, when migrating from step-asr / step-asr-1.1, or when hitting the misleading `model stepaudio-2.5-asr not supported` error (which actually means wrong endpoint). Triggers on 阶跃 ASR, StepFun ASR, stepaudio-2.5-asr, 转录, 语音识别, 长音频转写, 语音转文字. For TTS with the sibling stepaudio-2.5-tts model, use the stepfun-tts skill instead.

en.purpose: Transcribes Chinese or English audio through StepFun stepaudio-2.5-asr using its JSON/base64 SSE endpoint and extracts authoritative final text and usage data.
scenarios: Transcribe short or long recordings in one request when within service limits.
Migrate from older StepFun ASR models.
Diagnose wrong-endpoint, key-type, censorship-event, or repetitive-output failures.
en.io: Inputs are supported audio files, language/format options, and an API key. Outputs are plain transcript text or JSON containing text, usage, and timing information.
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY or plugin config with a Normal API key
ffmpeg for unsupported containers or files exceeding the single-call duration limit
en.boundary: Uses a StepFun-hosted service and does not provide speaker diarization or transcript cleanup. It must parse SSE error events and take final text from the done event. Audio beyond the stated ceiling must be split externally, and pricing/performance claims may change.

zh.purpose: 通过 StepFun stepaudio-2.5-asr 的 JSON/base64 SSE 接口转写中英文音频，并提取权威最终文本和用量数据。
scenarios: 在服务限制内单次转写短音频或较长录音。
从旧版 StepFun ASR 模型迁移。
诊断错误端点、密钥类型、内容拦截事件或重复幻觉问题。
zh.io: 输入为受支持的音频文件、语言/格式选项和 API Key；输出为纯文本转写或包含文本、用量与耗时信息的 JSON。
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY 或插件配置中的 Normal API Key
处理不支持容器或超时长文件时所需的 ffmpeg
zh.boundary: 依赖 StepFun 托管服务，不提供说话人分离或转写清理。必须处理 SSE error 事件，并以 done 事件的最终文本为准。超过单次时长限制的音频需外部分割，价格和性能数据可能变化。

skills.name: statusline-generator
skills.summary: Installs, configures, customizes, or troubleshoots the Claude Code statusline (cwd, model, token counts). Use when the user wants to set up or change the statusline, switch minimal vs full layouts, show absolute token counts (e.g. ctx 108K / 1M) instead of a percentage, add cost via ccusage or git status, dump the stdin JSON Claude Code passes the script, or fix a statusline that is blank, silent, stuck, shows "permission denied", or stopped updating after a script edit (often a missing chmod +x). Trigger phrases: "configure statusline", "statusline blank", "status line not showing", "statusline broken", "show token count in statusline", 状态栏, 状态栏不显示, 状态栏空白, 显示工作目录, 显示 token 数.

skills.name: read-codex-history
skills.summary: Reads, searches, and exports local OpenAI Codex history without continuing the old task. Lists recent Codex sessions, extracts exact prompt-ledger inputs by Session, locates a rollout by verified session_meta identity, reconstructs one chronological user/assistant timeline with fork and compaction lineage, and performs bounded keyword search across live and archived rollouts. Use whenever the user asks what they told Codex, wants recent original inputs, a Codex Session ID, full prior context, fork ancestry, or evidence of what a Codex run did. For Claude Code history use read-claude-code-history.

skills.name: read-claude-web-conversation
skills.summary: Read or export the COMPLETE transcript of a Claude.ai web conversation — both private claude.ai/chat/... and public claude.ai/share/... links — by calling Claude.ai's internal API from inside the user's logged-in Chrome, and download its FILES too (uploads, deliverables). Use whenever the user pastes a claude.ai conversation or share link and asks to read, summarize, export, archive, or extract it — "read this Claude conversation", "导出这个网页版对话", "把这个对话拉到本地". Every naive approach fails SILENTLY: curl/WebFetch hit a Cloudflare challenge; get_page_text sees only the last message; the default API rendering collapses tool calls into placeholders (~5% of it); a share payload uses block shapes a /chat/-only renderer drops without error. Works even when the claude-in-chrome extension cannot pair (different account), via CDP or a macOS AppleScript fallback. Scope: ONLINE claude.ai. For LOCAL Claude Code sessions use read-claude-code-history; for an exported .txt/.json file use claude-export-txt-better.

skills.name: read-claude-code-history
skills.summary: Reads, searches, and exports local Claude Code history without resuming work. Covers recent session inventory, exact session timelines, verbatim human input including queued mid-turn prompts, full-event keyword search, hybrid recall when wording changed, end-state triage, and deleted-file recovery across active Claude homes plus registered archives. Use whenever the user asks what they or Claude said, wants a Claude Code session ID or original context, remembers prior work vaguely, needs an old file from a transcript, or must prove what a Claude session contained before continuing it. Also owns the only Kimi CLI surface, via its Kimi inventory and search flags. For Codex history use read-codex-history; when the request names no platform at all or spans providers, start at local-conversation-history.

skills.name: prior-work-retrieval
skills.summary: Only for explicit prior-work/reuse/history requests; never for read-only status or inspection. Finds and verifies existing successful work before substantial new production when reuse is materially plausible. Use when the user explicitly references earlier work, existing code/SOPs, history, prior decisions, another project, or says 以前做过, 已有代码, 别重复造轮子, reuse, or retrieve before produce. A mention of current/现有 tests, README, files, implementation, behavior, or validation is not a prior-work request. Do not infer the trigger merely because new work might duplicate something. Do not invoke for current-file inspection, ordinary bug fixes, mechanical verification, or merely because the final answer is a report/summary. Produces a source-verified reuse/adapt/reject receipt; zero hits never prove absence.

skills.name: meeting-minutes-taker
skills.summary: Transforms raw meeting transcripts into high-fidelity, structured meeting minutes (notes / summaries). Use when (1) a meeting transcript is provided and meeting minutes, notes, or a summary are requested; (2) multiple versions of minutes must be merged without losing content; (3) existing minutes need review against the original transcript for missing items; (4) the transcript has anonymous speakers like "Speaker 1/2/3" or "发言人1" that need identifying (optionally mapped via a context.md team directory). Triggers on 会议纪要 / 会议记录 / 整理纪要 / 妙记转纪要, "write meeting minutes", "summarize this meeting", "merge these minutes", "what's missing from these notes". For fixing ASR/STT recognition errors in the raw transcript first, use transcript-fixer; this skill structures clean transcripts into minutes.

en.purpose: Transforms meeting transcripts into structured, evidence-backed minutes through redundant complete passes, union merging, completeness review, and human validation.
scenarios: Create minutes with decisions, action items, discussion, open questions, and supporting quotes.
Merge several minutes drafts without losing unique content.
Audit existing notes against a transcript or identify anonymous speakers with user-confirmed mappings.
en.io: Inputs are transcripts, optional project/team context, reference artifacts, and external draft minutes. Outputs are Markdown minutes, intermediate complete-pass drafts, diagrams, retrieval-test claims, and review statistics.
dependencies: Readable transcript and optional context files
Multiple isolated agent passes for the specified full workflow
Optional transcript-fixer and document conversion tools
en.boundary: Structures transcript evidence rather than correcting ASR. Speaker identity must not be silently inferred; source-side labeling or user confirmation is preferred. Drafts require human review, and claims from external drafts must be verified against the transcript.

zh.purpose: 通过多次独立完整生成、并集合并、完整性审查和人工确认，将会议转写整理为有证据支撑的结构化纪要。
scenarios: 生成包含决策、行动项、讨论、开放问题和原文引述的会议纪要。
合并多份纪要版本并保留各版本独有内容。
对照原始转写审查现有纪要，或在用户确认下识别匿名说话人。
zh.io: 输入为会议转写、可选项目/团队上下文、参考材料和外部纪要草稿；输出为 Markdown 纪要、多轮中间稿、图表、检索自测声明及审查统计。
dependencies: 可读取的转写和可选上下文文件
完整流程要求的多次隔离代理生成
Markdown 与 Mermaid 渲染能力
可选的 transcript-fixer 和文档转换工具
zh.boundary: 用于组织转写证据，不负责纠正 ASR。不得静默猜测说话人身份，应优先使用源平台标注或用户确认。产物是需人工审阅的草稿，外部版本中的内容必须回到原转写核验。

skills.name: marketplace-dev
skills.summary: Creates and maintains Claude Code plugin marketplaces, consolidates standalone skills into a new or existing suite, and moves skills between suites. Converts any Claude Code skills repository into an official plugin marketplace, generates spec-conforming .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, validates with `claude plugin validate`, tests real installation and cache boundaries, and PRs the upstream repo, encoding hard-won schema/version/description anti-patterns. Use when the user mentions marketplace, plugin support, one-click install, marketplace.json, plugin distribution, auto-update, suite-only migration, "put these skills in a suite", "move this skill into daymade-*", or wants a skills repo installable via `claude plugin install`.

skills.name: local-conversation-history
skills.summary: Entry point for local AI conversation history across providers. Routes a request to the one skill that owns it, by platform (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Kimi CLI) and action (read evidence vs continue interrupted work), and owns the one job none of them own alone: a single inventory spanning all three providers. Use when the provider is unknown or plural ("our history", "what have I been working on", "which chats did I have"), when the user wants Kimi CLI history at all, when it is unclear whether they need evidence or resumption, or when they ask for this skill by name. Vague recall that names no platform ("we discussed this once, when was it?") belongs here rather than to a single-provider reader, because a Claude-only answer to an unscoped question cannot support an absence claim. When the platform and the action are both already clear, load that executor skill directly instead — except Kimi CLI, which has no reader or continuation skill of its own and always routes through here.

skills.name: lark-cli-router
skills.summary: Routes any Feishu/Lark/Doubao operation through the version-matched lark-cli domain guide embedded in the installed CLI, then executes and verifies the requested task. Use for 飞书/Lark/Doubao docs, drive, sheets, Base, wiki, minutes, meetings, calendar, IM, mail, tasks, approval, apps, auth/scope, resource URLs or tokens, and lark-cli troubleshooting. This is the single Lark entry point; use ima-skill instead for Tencent IMA.

skills.name: fixing-claude-export-conversations
skills.summary: Fixes broken line wrapping in Claude Code exported conversation files (.txt), reconstructing tables, paragraphs, paths, and tool calls that were hard-wrapped at fixed column widths. Includes an automated validation suite (generic, file-agnostic checks). Triggers when the user has a Claude Code export file with broken formatting, mentions "fix export", "fix conversation", "exported conversation", "make export readable", references a file matching YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-*.txt, or has a .txt file with broken tables, split paths, or mangled tool output from Claude Code.

skills.name: continue-codex-work
skills.summary: Continues interrupted OpenAI Codex work only after read-codex-history verifies the selected rollout identity and complete fork/compaction lineage. Use when the user provides a Codex Session ID, asks to pick up a prior Codex run, says Codex was interrupted, fused, compacted, or stuck, or wants the current Agent to take over without `codex resume`. Restores the original business outcome, unfulfilled requests, user corrections, proven prior assets, current workspace truth, and the next action that directly advances the goal. Do not use when Codex itself natively resumed this same conversation and its prior turns or compaction state are already present in the current context.

skills.name: continue-claude-code-work
skills.summary: Continues interrupted Claude Code work only after local history has been read and reconciled. Use when the user provides a Claude Code Session ID, asks to pick up prior Claude work, says a Claude run was interrupted or compacted, or wants the current Agent to take over without `claude --resume`. Reconstructs the original business outcome, unfulfilled requests, user corrections, successful prior assets, current workspace truth, and the next action that directly advances the goal. For Codex sessions use continue-codex-work.

skills.name: competitors-analysis
skills.summary: Discover, clone, update, and analyze competitor repositories with evidence-based competitive intelligence. Use when tracking competitors, reviewing competitor source code, adding a competitor repository, comparing product capabilities, building a competitor landscape, checking whether competitor code changed, or when the user says "竞品分析", "竞品", "competitor scan", "latest competitor code", "analyze competitor", or "compare with X". Repository-backed findings must come from local cloned code with file:line citations; market-landscape claims must cite their source and volatility.

en.purpose: Builds auditable competitor profiles and landscapes from locally inspected repository evidence, supplemented by sourced market facts and explicitly separated judgments.
scenarios: Discover and shortlist relevant open-source competitors.
Profile a competitor's implementation, dependencies, capabilities, and direction.
Compare competitors and derive evidence-linked gaps or opportunities.
en.io: Inputs are a product scope, target segment, competitor repository URLs or search terms, local clones, and public market sources. Outputs are source registers, cited technical profiles, comparison tables, and qualified opportunity/risk analyses.
dependencies: GitHub CLI for discovery and repository metadata
Web access for official market, pricing, or activity sources
Bundled update script and report templates
en.boundary: Technical conclusions require local code and file:line evidence; UI appearance alone is insufficient. Market facts need sources and retrieval dates. Missing evidence is marked for verification rather than guessed, and opportunity statements remain judgments rather than code facts.

zh.purpose: 基于本地检查的代码仓库证据构建可审计的竞品档案和竞争格局，并补充有来源的市场事实，同时明确区分事实与判断。
scenarios: 发现并筛选相关开源竞品。
分析竞品的实现、依赖、能力和近期方向。
比较多个竞品并提炼有证据关联的差距与机会。
zh.io: 输入为产品范围、目标客群、竞品仓库 URL 或搜索词、本地克隆和公开市场信源；输出为来源登记、带引用的技术档案、对比表及附条件的机会/风险分析。
dependencies: 用于发现与元数据查询的 GitHub CLI
查询官方市场、价格或活跃度信息所需的网络访问
内置更新脚本和报告模板
zh.boundary: 技术结论必须来自本地代码和 file:line 证据，不能仅凭界面推断。市场事实须附来源和获取日期。证据不足时应标为待验证，不得猜测；机会属于分析判断而非代码事实。

skills.name: codex-1m-context-window-setup
skills.summary: Configures and verifies an expanded, model-aware context window for OpenAI Codex CLI and Codex Desktop by safely updating the shared base config. Use whenever Codex shows about 258K context, the user asks for 500K or 1M context, auto-compaction happens too often, model_context_window or model_auto_compact_token_limit needs repair, or a workstation/classroom needs the same long-context setup across macOS and Windows. Detects the selected model's live maximum, requests up to 1M tokens, sets compaction to 60% of the attainable window, preserves unrelated TOML, backs up changes, and fails rather than guessing when the model contract cannot be verified.

skills.name: cloudflare-troubleshooting
skills.summary: Investigate and resolve Cloudflare configuration issues using API-driven evidence gathering. Use when troubleshooting ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS, SSL errors, DNS issues, or any Cloudflare-related problems. Focus on systematic investigation using Cloudflare API to examine actual configuration rather than making assumptions.

en.purpose: Investigates Cloudflare delivery problems by querying actual zone configuration, checking related layers, applying narrowly scoped fixes, and verifying results.
scenarios: Diagnose redirect loops and SSL/TLS mode conflicts.
Investigate DNS, DNSSEC, certificate, firewall, load-balancer, or origin errors.
Inspect Cloudflare settings before changing configuration.
en.io: Inputs are a domain, Cloudflare zone/account access, observed symptoms, and origin details. Outputs are configuration evidence, a root-cause assessment, optional API mutations, and post-change verification results.
dependencies: Scoped API token or Global API key plus account email
curl and JSON parsing such as jq

zh.purpose: 通过多 Agent 并行只读审查 git diff 或指定文件，综合检测代码的行为回归、安全风险、性能隐患及测试覆盖缺口。
scenarios: 在提交代码或创建 PR 前对当前 git 变更进行多维度并行审查
对修改的文件进行专项安全、隐私风险与行为回归排查
评估分支对比中的性能瓶颈、契约失效与测试缺口
zh.io: 输入 git 变更、分支对比或指定文件路径，输出按优先级排序的高价值问题汇总及建议修复路径。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅执行只读审查，绝不修改文件、应用补丁、暂存变更或自动应用任何修复。

skills.name: review-and-simplify-changes
skills.summary: Review a git diff or explicit file scope for reuse, code quality, efficiency, clarity, and standards issues, then optionally apply safe Codex-driven fixes. en.purpose: Reviews git diffs or specific files for code reuse, quality, efficiency, and clarity issues using parallel read-only sub-agents, optionally applying safe, behavior-preserving fixes.
scenarios: Auditing git diffs before committing to ensure code quality and avoid duplicated logic.
Simplifying and cleaning up recent code changes to improve efficiency and maintainability.
Checking specific files against local repository standards and running validation tests post-refactor.
en.io: Inputs a git diff, file scope, and operational mode (review-only, safe-fixes, or fix-and-validate); outputs structured review findings and optionally safe code edits.
en.boundary: Does not apply unsafe or speculative code changes, nor does it allow review sub-agents to directly mutate workspace state or edit files.

zh.purpose: 利用并行只读子代理审查 Git 变动或指定文件中的代码复用、质量、效率及规范问题，并可选择性地应用安全的重构修复。
scenarios: 在代码提交前审查暂存区或工作区的 Git 变更，检查是否存在重复逻辑和质量问题
对近期修改的代码进行简化和重构，以提升代码可读性与执行效率
针对指定文件核对本地项目规范，并在修改后执行基础校验测试
zh.io: 输入为 Git 差异范围、指定文件路径及操作模式（仅审查、安全修复或修复并验证），输出为结构化审查报告及可选的安全代码修改。
zh.boundary: 不会执行低置信度或改变原有行为的破坏性重构，且禁止审查子代理直接修改文件或变更工作区状态。

skills.name: react-component-performance
skills.summary: Analyze and optimize React component performance issues (slow renders, re-render thrash, laggy lists, expensive computations). Use when asked to profile or improve a React component, reduce re-renders, or speed up UI updates in React apps.

Optimizing heavy lists and expensive calculations using virtualization and memoization
Isolating fast-changing state and stabilizing callbacks/props to reduce unnecessary re-renders
en.io: Inputs React component source code or performance profiling data and outputs optimized React code along with profiling recommendations.
en.boundary: Does not address backend network latency, server-side performance issues, or non-React frontend framework optimizations.

zh.purpose: 提供系统化的模式和工作流，用于在不修改 UI 功能的前提下识别、隔离并优化 React 组件的性能瓶颈。
scenarios: 排查并修复 React 组件中的渲染卡顿和频繁无用重渲染问题
通过虚拟化和记忆化技术优化大列表渲染与高开销计算
隔离高频变动状态并稳定回调函数与 Props 以防止组件级联渲染
zh.io: 输入 React 组件源码或性能分析数据，输出优化后的 React 代码及性能验证建议。
zh.boundary: 不涉及后端网络延迟、服务器端性能调优或非 React 前端框架的性能优化。

skills.name: project-skill-audit
